footnote_text: On October 28, 2026, the Reporting Person exercised the incentive stock option granted 10/14/2021 under the Company's 2017 Stock Option Plan (the "2017 Plan") for the purchase of 5,000 shares of the Company's Common Stock at an exercise price of $7.005 per share (the "Option shares"). As permitted by the 2017 Plan, the Reporting Person elected to pay the exercise price of the Option Shares by having the Company withhold from the Option Shares a number of shares having a fair market value equal to the aggregate exercise price of $35,025. Since the fair market value of the Company's Common Stock on October 28, 2026, (as determined in accordance with the 2017 Plan) was $13.66 per share, the Company withheld 2,564 shares of Common Stock ($35,025 divided by $13.66) to pay the aggregate exercise price of the option.
